sources.entry: Drop - Game distribution platform, designed for distributing and sharing DRM-free games efficiently (alternative to Steam, GameVault). (Source Code, Clients) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Drop-app is the desktop client for Drop, a self-hosted game distribution platform for sharing DRM-free games, but its README only says the repository has moved to a monorepo.
summary.what_it_does: The README is nearly empty: it contains only a "Moved" notice saying this repo has been moved to a monorepo, with no link given. It does not describe features, setup, or architecture. The awesome-selfhosted listing describes Drop as a game distribution platform for distributing and sharing DRM-free games, with source code and clients, and lists AGPL-3.0 and Docker. Those details come from the listing, not the README, so treat them as unverified here.
use_cases: share games with friends or a group
notable: Desktop client repository for the Drop game distribution platform
Repository has been moved to a monorepo, per the README
Listed on awesome-selfhosted under Games - Administrative Utilities & Control Panels
caveats: README is nearly empty and only points to a move to a monorepo, with no link given
